title: Inbound & Outbound Tourism
desc: With many years of experience in the hospitality and travel industry, Flash Tour has built a diverse global portfolio in multiple destinations. We have expanded our locations around the world, offering hotels in many countries ranging from Nile cruises, Boutique hotels, Resorts and Boats. Our hospitality style is diverse, whether you wake up to the sound of the waves of the Indian Ocean or find yourself sailing on one of the largest rivers in the world, departing from a city to wake up in another one.

title: Flight Reservations
desc: Our team will handle all ticketing procedures as we have partnered up with IATA. Via the Amadeus system, we are able to view and reserve airline tickets for our clients after analyzing the best options available.

title: Hotel Reservations
desc: We have established strong contacts with a wide range of hotels across the region, both in terms of luxury and range of facilities as well as location. Our extensive network ensures a variety of locations and facilities to suit every type of traveler. With competitive rates and exclusive deals, we offer our partners and clients exceptional value and flexibility when selecting accommodations.

title: Tour Guiding Services
desc: We have a professional team that offers full guidance in several languages. All our team members are bilingual and certified.

title: Transportation
desc: We offer a variety of Private VIP cars, limousines, coasters, shuttles, up to 50 seater buses. With a fleet of more than 100 vehicles, we guarantee our clients a wide variety of transports that exceed international standards.

title: Leisure: Individuals & Groups
desc: We provide high-quality tailor-made travel solutions for niche markets as well as customized services for large leisure groups. Our focus is on creating flexible and memorable experiences that meet the expectations of both individual travelers (FIT) and organized group segments.

title: Premium FIT & Family Travel
desc: Our experts specialize in designing fully customized travel experiences for FIT clients and families. We manage every detail of the journey, including transfers, accommodations, and curated excursions, ensuring each trip is personalized to specific preferences and comfort levels.

title: Fully Escorted Group Tours
desc: For travelers who enjoy shared experiences, we offer fully escorted small group tours ranging from 12 to 24 guests. These journeys are thoughtfully designed to combine discovery, comfort, and social travel, including unique itineraries that go beyond traditional tourist routes.

title: Hajj and Umrah
desc: We provide complete Hajj and Umrah travel services for our Egyptian clients, ensuring a smooth and spiritually focused journey. Our team manages all arrangements including flights, transportation, hotel bookings, and on-ground assistance, while also accommodating special requirements with care and respect.

title: Airport Services
desc: We deliver premium airport assistance services designed to enhance comfort and convenience for travelers. These include Marhaba services, lounge access, and 24/7 airport support from our dedicated team. We also provide shuttle transfers to ensure seamless arrivals and departures.

title: MICE Management
desc: In the UAE, we specialize in managing large-scale corporate travel and business events through a dedicated in-house MICE team. We handle meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions with a professional approach tailored to corporate standards and objectives, ensuring smooth execution from planning to delivery.

title: Visa Services
desc: We offer efficient UAE entry visa services at competitive rates for both tourism and business travel purposes. Our team ensures a smooth application process with reliable support, helping clients obtain visas with ease and confidence.

title: Golf Travel Services
desc: Since the UAE is a leading destination for golf enthusiasts, our Flash Horizon Golf team brings extensive experience and strong industry connections to deliver premium golf travel experiences. From curated packages to green fees and tournament arrangements, we ensure every detail is executed "to a tee," offering a seamless and elevated golfing journey.
